messages:
Maria Chen: Quick check — planning a hybrid procurement (A100 + H100) across GCP and AWS for a new Dedicated pool. Two asks: (1) prefer single-vendor sequencing or parallel shipments? (2) who owns telemetry hooks for early-provisioned nodes (we need per-pool NVML/KV cache metrics). cc @Aj Patel @Lee Gomez

Aj Patel: Parallel shipments reduce vendor risk, but we must lock quota holds first. I already have a GCP quota request in us-west1 for 16 A100s (req `Q-1429`). For AWS I can open the PO but need BU signoff. My suggested waves: 8 GPUs -> smoke, then remaining 8.

Lee Gomez: Parallel + two waves sounds right. Network note: RDMA path needs MTU 9000 + jumbo frames on rack switches, and ensure PMTU across transit VPC. Also add this to bootstrap for nodes for easier perf debugging:
```
# cloud-init snippet
ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off
sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=16777216
```

Zack Miller: I can own telemetry. Plan: node-exporter + nvml collector + per-pool labels in Prometheus. Will add Grafana dashboard and an alert for GPU ECC spikes. I'll open a PR to infra/telemetry and tag y'all.

vendor_sam: Hi — NimbleSupply here. Current ETA for first H100 rack ~6-8 weeks after PO. We can prioritize scheduling if you give a firm ship window. Also need rack elevation + PDU details; will DM checklist. We can offer split-ship but need confirmed network/PDUs before staging.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance in us-west1 at 1999994330 — short 5m maintenance that may affect initial provisioning (locks, image pulls).

Maria Chen: Action items — Aj to lock AWS PO by EOD Wed; Lee to confirm MTU/jumbo frames with network team; Zack to open the telemetry PR; vendor_sam to propose earliest ship windows and SOW. I'll draft a short RFC for sequencing and staging. :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: Ack. Will update with PO number once submitted.

vendor_sam: Will send SOW + staging rack requirements tomorrow morning. If you can share expected start date window that helps prioritize the slot.

Zack Miller: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/782 — includes node exporter config and nvml collector. PTAL @Maria Chen.

Maria Chen: Great, moving to async tracking. If no objections I'll add this plan to infra roadmap and close the loop here. :rocket:
